prompt: Create one complete horizontal 16:9 medieval leaded STAINED-GLASS artwork, one coherent scene. The ENTIRE image must be made of translucent colored glass pieces separated by clearly visible dark lead cames: faces, hands, robes, objects, terrain and sky. Lead seams cross inside faces along forehead, brows, nose bridge, cheekbones and jaw; 10-16 facial panes, not smooth painted skin inside a stained-glass border. Believable natural anatomy and subtle expression, not cartoon, not photorealistic painting. Jewel-toned handmade glass, uneven texture, directional transmitted light with readable shadows. Environment and figures one continuous perspective, no comic panels or webpage cards. Keep key faces, hands and props within central 80% of image. No text, no lettering, no readable runes, no watermark, no logos, no crosses or unrelated religious imagery.  Theme subtitle for semantic guidance ONLY, do not draw words: 无需功绩，也值得被爱. Single moment beneath an ancient living tree in Feralas: adult green-skinned orc Thrall with blue eyes and black braids, simple earth-brown shaman robe, reverently holding a small ordinary acorn he has just picked up from the ground. Nearby Desharin appears as a green-haired purple-skinned male night elf, long ears, watching quietly; NOT a dragon. Massive old tree trunk and deep forest foliage dominate environment; quiet shafts of filtered green and amber light. Small acorn, not glowing magical weapon. Thrall's face shows humility and wonder. No armor, no family apparitions, no timeline collage, no hammer held in his occupied hands.
